statements.attributed: demonstrated the superior stability of the HEA structure
statements.quote: The excellent durability of N–Pt/HEA/C catalyst is probably attributed to (i) the superior stability of the HEA structure, promoting ORR stability in the harsh environment through sluggish diffusion; (ii) the formation of chemically stable M-N bonds, inducing the pinning effect and effectively precluding metal dissolution from the nanoparticles; and (iii) the Pt-rich shell, preventing the core and thus significantly enhancing the oxidation and dissolution resistance.
